name: base_pbd_brick
description: run_envs.DEFAULT_SIM: joint stiffness and damping fitted to master's PBD vine (fit_to_master.py) and then to the 15 brick demos (video/demos, 2.3 kg brick assumed, 20 N stall force), rescaled from 18 mm to 30 mm segments; vine radius and box size from real_measurements.md. obj_friction 0.08 is not fitted for the 0.503 kg box.
